chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Shall I inform you of the worst of you?' They said, 'Yes, O Messenger of Allah!' He said: 'Those who walk about spreading gossip, the separators between lovers, the seekers of faults of the righteous, the fault-finders.'

key_terms.النَّمِيمَةِ: Gossip / Spreading tales to cause discord
key_terms.الْبَاغُونَ: The seekers / Those who hunt for

ai.seo_question: What are the four characteristics of the worst people according to the Prophet in this hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) identifies four traits of the 'worst' among people: those who spread gossip (namimah), create discord between friends, seek faults in the innocent, and are constant fault-finders. This narration emphasizes social ethics and the importance of maintaining harmony within the community. The hadith is significant in Shia scholarship for its focus on the moral character of individuals and their impact on social cohesion.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Shall I inform you with the most evil of you all?’ They said, ‘Yes, O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>!’ He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The informers with the gossip, the separators between the loves ones, the aspirers to faulting the righteous ones’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al- Hassan ibn Mahbub from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:

‘‘The Messenger of Allah has asked, ‘Should I tell you who the evil ones among you are?’ They said, ‘Yes, O Messenger of Allah.’ The Messenger of Allah said, ‘They are those who spread gossip that causes separation among the loved ones and those who seek to label the innocent with faults.’”
